title.en: Video models publish verified group protocols
title.zh: 视频模型发布已验证分组协议

summary.en: Video models with verified group rules now publish account-scoped `effective_video` variants. Same-protocol models inherit the model-level `gateway_protocol`; mixed-protocol groups declare their own create and query protocol.
summary.zh: 具备已核验分组规则的视频模型现在发布账号级 `effective_video` 变体。同协议模型沿用模型级 `gateway_protocol`，混合协议分组在组内声明自己的创建与查询协议。

body.en:
## Video group capabilities

`GET /api/pricing` model rows and `GET /api/model_contract/:model` responses can now publish an account-scoped `effective_video` view for video models with verified group rules. Each group maps to complete operation variants. Match the whole request against one variant and use `model@group` to select a group explicitly.

## Protocol inheritance

Read the variant's `gateway_protocol`; when absent, inherit the model-level `contract.gateway_protocol`. Same-protocol models keep the model-level protocol on their variants, while mixed-protocol groups declare their own protocol. Use the matching create and query routes: `openai_video` on `POST /v1/videos` / `GET /v1/videos/{task_id}`, and `video_generations` on `POST /v1/video/generations` / `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`. When a model whose default protocol is `openai_video` selects a native variant, send `X-OmniMux-Video-Protocol: video_generations` on `POST /v1/video/generations`.

Retries stay in the selected group, and accepted tasks are queried by their original record and protocol. The existing pilot behavior remains compatible.
body.zh:
## 视频分组能力

`GET /api/pricing` 的模型行与 `GET /api/model_contract/:model` 的响应现在可为具备已核验分组规则的视频模型发布账号级 `effective_video` 视图。每个分组映射到完整操作变体；请求必须匹配其中一个完整变体，并可用 `model@group` 显式选择分组。

## 协议继承

读取变体的 `gateway_protocol`；缺省时继承模型级 `contract.gateway_protocol`。同协议模型在变体上沿用模型级协议，混合协议分组则在组内声明各自协议。按对应协议使用创建与查询入口：`openai_video` 使用 `POST /v1/videos` / `GET /v1/videos/{task_id}`，`video_generations` 使用 `POST /v1/video/generations` / `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`。模型默认协议为 `openai_video` 且选择原生变体时，在 `POST /v1/video/generations` 携带 `X-OmniMux-Video-Protocol: video_generations`。

重试保持在所选分组内，已受理任务按原任务记录和协议查询。既有试点行为保持兼容。
